about: The deepest dependency chain the static engine compiles at each compiler's default template depth, per shape: written by tests/chain_depth/check_chain_depth.py --deepest --record (task T1.11), which documents the shapes and how a chain is compiled, under each preset's name, with cl's version on MSVC. NFR-09 asks for 200 hops, 150 on MSVC before 19.50 (ADR-0014). 'deepest' compiles and 'deepest' + 1 doesn't, stopped as 'stopped_by' says. 'include' is the tree id of include/ at the measurement, which a rebase or a squash keeps, unlike 'commit': the tests say when include/ is no longer that tree. Re-measure after changing include/trellis/static/ or include/trellis/discovery/.
